User (1.7s): Yes, this is Hannah Schmidt.

Assistant (9.3s): Please tell me your date of birth, with the month as a word.

User (10.4s): Twenty-eight April nineteen ninety-three.

Assistant (23.6s): Please tell me the last four digits of the phone number on file.

User (25.2s): Three three one seven.

Assistant (30.5s): I am calling from the collections team about a late payment on your credit card ending 5512. The past-due amount is 180.0, and it is 5 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (31.9s): I actually paid it in the app this morning.

Assistant (39.5s): Please go on.

User (40.8s): I already made the payment through the app today.

Assistant (46.6s): Please go on.

User (48.3s): I've already processed the payment through the app this morning.

Assistant (61.0s): I could not understand the answer clearly. Please use the mobile app or a branch. Thank you. Goodbye.
